title: arnavkj1995/WEAVER
abstract:
WEAVER is an efficient, consistent and high-fidelity world model enabling state-of-the-art robot policy evaluation, improvement, and faster test-time planning.

# WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation Arnav Kumar Jain 1,2,* , Yilin Wu 3,* , Jesse Farebrother 1,4 , Gokul Swamy 3 , Andrea Bajcsy 3 [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13672) [ ](https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/) [ ](https://x.com/arnavkj95/status/2066919523685380387?s=20) [ ](https://huggingface.co/arnavkj1995/WEAVER) [ ](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yilin-wu/droid_ood_data) [ ](LICENSE) --- We introduce WEAVER: a world model architecture that satisfies the three desiderata: (i) fidelity, (ii) consistency, and (iii) efficiency. WEAVER unlocks state-of-the-art performance across policy evaluation (ρ = 0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of 38% on top of the π0.5 robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of 14% with a 5–10× speedup over prior WMs). ## 🛠️ Setup Create a Python 3.11 environment and install dependencies with `uv`. For optional logging and development dependencies: You can also run commands directly through `uv`: ## Model Checkpoints and Datasets Download all released checkpoints from [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/arnavkj1995/WEAVER): This downloads the `WEAVER`, `WEAVER-FT`, and `WEAVER-ReFlow` folders. Each folder contains `checkpoint.pt`, `config.yaml`, and `norm_stats_relabel.json`. The OOD evaluation dataset used in this work is available at [yilin-wu/droid_ood_data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yilin-wu/droid_ood_data). Or with the Python library: To download only annotations and metadata (without videos/latents): ## 📁 Repository Structure This repository implements the main WEAVER components: the latent flow world model, DROID dataloaders, reward and critic heads, rollout generation, and offline evaluation utilities. ## 💾 Datasets WEAVER expects preprocessed DROID-style trajectories with actions, states, language features, rewards, normalization statistics, and either view vide
abstract_zh: WEAVER 是一个高效、一致且高保真的世界模型，能够实现最先进的机器人策略评估、改进以及更快的测试时规划。我们提出 WEAVER：一种满足三项核心需求的世界模型架构：（i）保真度，（ii）一致性，（iii）效率。WEAVER 在策略评估（与真实世界成功率的相关系数 ρ = 0.870）、策略改进（在 π0.5 机器人基础模型之上将真实世界成功率提升 38%）以及测试时规划（真实世界成功率提升 14%，相比先前世界模型实现 5–10 倍加速）方面均达到最先进性能。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 WEAVER，一个基于潜空间流匹配（latent flow world model）的操作世界模型架构，在预处理的 DROID 风格轨迹（含动作、状态、语言特征、奖励）上训练，并配合奖励头与 critic 头，通过生成 rollout 支持策略评估、策略改进与测试时规划。


# 一、动机

> 现有的机器人操作世界模型难以同时满足保真度、长时一致性与效率：高保真模型推理慢、难以用于在线规划，而快速模型又容易在长程 rollout 中漂移，导致策略评估与测试时规划不可靠。


# 二、方法

> 提出 WEAVER，一个基于潜空间流匹配（latent flow world model）的操作世界模型架构，在预处理的 DROID 风格轨迹（含动作、状态、语言特征、奖励）上训练，并配合奖励头与 critic 头，通过生成 rollout 支持策略评估、策略改进与测试时规划。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) 策略评估与真实世界成功率的相关系数达 ρ = 0.870；2) 在 π0.5 机器人基础模型之上，真实世界成功率提升 38%；3) 测试时规划带来 14% 的真实世界成功率提升，同时比此前世界模型快 5–10×。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该工作说明「保真—一致—高效」三者可通过潜空间流式建模同时兼顾，为用世界模型替代昂贵真机评估提供了可行路径；局限在于摘要未披露失败案例与消融细节，其效果依赖 DROID 规模数据与预训练基础模型，在接触密集、长时序任务上的泛化性仍待验证。
